name: hallmark
description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
one_liner: A rulebook that an AI coding assistant follows so the websites and apps it designs stop looking like generic 'made by AI' templates, and instead look like something a real design studio made.
buyer: A solo founder or small agency shipping a product landing page or app UI who can't afford a designer but doesn't want their site to look AI-generated.
business_use_cases: A solo SaaS founder uses it to redesign their landing page so it looks hand-crafted instead of like every other AI-built startup site.
A small web agency installs it across client projects as a built-in quality bar, letting them promise 'no generic AI design' as a selling point.
A no-code/low-code tool bundles it under the hood so every site its users generate looks distinct rather than templated.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'redesign and audit' service: run Hallmark's audit/redesign commands on a client's existing site and deliver a polished version.
Build a hosted SaaS wrapper that lets non-technical founders paste a URL and get a Hallmark-styled rebuild, charging per project.

steal_this: Offer a weekend 'landing page glow-up' service: run `/hallmark redesign` on a founder's existing site, ship the result same-day, charge a flat fee.
